nasa_apod.title: Moons, Rings, Shadows, Clouds: Saturn (Cassini)
nasa_apod.explanation: While cruising around Saturn, be on the lookout for picturesque arrangements of moons, rings, and shadows. One such striking sight occurred in 2005 and was captured by the then Saturn-orbiting Cassini spacecraft. In the featured image, moons Mimas (left) and Tethys (right) are visible on either side...
